title: Gap record
description: Emitted by `grc gap`, not hand-authored. Four directions of gap, each meaning something different and each with a different fix.

direction.description: coverage: a framework requirement with no control. assurance: a control with no executable evidence. remediation: an open finding with no operating control behind it. risk: a scenario with nothing mitigating it.

subject.description: The framework identifier, control_id, finding_id or scenario_id the gap is about

severity_basis.description: Why this ranks where it does, in words. Never a bare number.
